author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices skipping keys with fingers 1-3-5, notes in pairs, patterns going up and down, predicting a surprise and soft-versus-loud playing, with Haydn's tiptoe tune.

classes.title: Tiptoe fingers 1, 3, 5
classes.goal: Place the hand on C and find the skip-a-key notes C, E and G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Play one key, skip one, play the next

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child rest the thumb on C, then touch C, E, G, skipping a key each time.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C. Tiptoe C, E, G: skip a key each time.
classes.bridge: The tune tiptoes over every other key, like stepping on stones across a stream.

intro.caption: Shh... tiptoe fingers, ready
intro.parentCue: whisper, and curve your child's fingers gently

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C, E and G by skipping keys.

classes.title: Tiptoe in pairs
classes.goal: Play the first line and notice every note comes twice, in pairs.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each note comes twice: two Cs, two Es, two Gs

classes.parentPrompt: Whisper 'one, two' for each pair as your child plays it.
classes.childAction: Play each note twice: C, C, E, E, G, G, then E.
classes.bridge: Every note brings a twin: two tiptoes on each stepping stone.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing notes that come in pairs.

classes.title: Tiptoe back down
classes.goal: Play the second line, which skips down; the grown-up plays the low notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Line one skips up; line two skips back down

classes.parentPrompt: Grown-up, you play the low B and G; your child plays F, F, D, D.
classes.childAction: Play F, F, D, D; then your grown-up tiptoes lower.
classes.bridge: Line one tiptoes up the stones to the right; line two tiptoes back left.

intro.caption: Now we tiptoe down
intro.parentCue: you play the low B and G

games.caption: Everybody, shh, shh, shh
games.parentCue: Lower your hand as the lights go down

games.caption: Your part: F, F, D, D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern going up, then down.

classes.title: Where is the surprise?
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and guess where the pattern changes into a surprise.

mathTarget.parentLine: Line three starts like line one, then breaks the pattern

classes.parentPrompt: Grown-up, you play the high boo note; ask 'when is it coming?' before line three.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and guess: when will the boo come?
classes.bridge: Line three walks the same stones, then jumps to a high stone: Boo!

intro.caption: Somewhere hides a boo!
intro.parentCue: you play the high C, the boo

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: guessing where a pattern changes.

classes.title: Skip, don't step
classes.goal: Practise skipping keys slowly with fingers 1, 3 and 5.

mathTarget.parentLine: A skip jumps over one key; a step goes next door

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand lightly on your child's wrist so the hand stays still; only fingers move.
classes.childAction: Play C, E, G, E with fingers 1, 3, 5, 3.
classes.bridge: Fingers 2 and 4 rest their feet; fingers 1, 3, 5 hop the stones.

intro.caption: Hop over one key
intro.parentCue: go slowly; the hand stays in its place

games.caption: Hop: 1, 3, 5, 3
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers with each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: skipping keys with fingers 1, 3 and 5.

classes.title: Count four tiptoes
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly while counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Beats come in groups of four: one, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: Whisper '1, 2, 3, 4' slowly and evenly; tap your child's shoulder on 1.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and evenly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Four tiptoes, then start again: one, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Tiptoe, tiptoe: 1, 2, 3, 4
intro.parentCue: whisper the count slowly and evenly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats in a bar.

classes.title: Tiptoe with the orchestra
classes.goal: Play the song along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Tiptoe your fingers on your knee beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep tiptoeing!
classes.bridge: Haydn wrote this tune for a whole orchestra; your fingers tiptoe with them.

intro.caption: The orchestra is tiptoeing too
intro.parentCue: tiptoe your fingers on your knee to help

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: A surprise for teddy
classes.goal: Play softly for teddy, then the grown-up plays the big boo.

mathTarget.parentLine: Very quiet, then one big sound: the contrast is the fun

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the boo loud, then laugh and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play soft tiptoe notes, then jump with teddy at the boo.
classes.bridge: Haydn hid one big loud chord in a quiet tune; that is the surprise.

intro.caption: Shh... teddy doesn't know!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing very softly, then a surprise.
